senses.gloss: m. pl. (v. מֵרְדָא) rebellious acts, political crimes, esp. the unauthorized exercise of criminal jurisdiction by Jews under the Parthian government.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:20">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>עד האידנא מלכותא דיוונאי הוו</he> … <he>השתא פרסאי נינהו</he> … <he>ואמרי מ׳ מ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) formerly the rulers were Greeks who cared not about bloodshed (execution by unauthorized courts), but now they are Persians (Parthians) who do care &c., and cry, rebellion! rebellion!—

B. Mets. 39ᵃ בורח מחמת מ׳ who flees from persecution for political offenses; B. Bath. 38ᵇ. [Hai Gaon derives our w. from the Persian, giving it the meaning of murder; Fl. to Levy Talm. Dict. III, p. 317ᵇ suggests murdan, to die.]
